III. SUMMARY OF OUR CONCLUSION

316. We summarise our final conclusion as under: -


    1. Detection and Removal of CSEAM through Hash Matching and
       URL Listing.

    1A. The Union of India shall provide information, by way of an

        affidavit, on the tools and technological measures that have been

        put in place by intermediaries for the detection and removal of

        CSEAM from their platforms.

    1B. Appropriate guidelines or standard operating procedure shall be

        framed by the Union of India for the use of perceptual hash-

        matching and URL listing by all significant social media

        intermediaries for the detection and removal of CSEAM from

        their platforms.

    1C. The above guidelines or standard operating procedure shall

        further stipulate other tools and technological measures that must



    M.A. Nos. 2553-2554 of 2026                            Page 122 of 136
    be deployed by every intermediary for the detection and removal

    of CSEAM. In this regard, appropriate amendments shall also be

    made to the IT Rules, where necessary.

1D. Such guidelines or standard operating procedure shall be revised

    periodically by the Ministry of Electronics and Information

    Technology.

1E. The Union of India shall further indicate, by way of an affidavit,

    the feasibility of an industry-wide use and deployment of such

    tools by all intermediaries.



2. Creation and Use of National Hash & URL List Database.

2A. The Union of India shall create a National Hash & URL List

    Database for the sole purpose of the detection and removal of

    CSEAM. Such a database may be created as part of the Sahyog

    Portal or as a standalone repository.

2B. Any entry within the National Hash & URL List Database shall

    only be made after a thorough assessment of the material through

    multiple tiers of verification. Such assessment may involve

    preliminary screening of the material by specialised software;

    however, the final determination or screening shall be done by at



M.A. Nos. 2553-2554 of 2026                            Page 123 of 136
    least three trained human analysts, who would independently

    determine whether the material in question constitutes CSEAM.

2C. Where any material upon such assessment is confirmed to be

    CSEAM, the perceptual hash identifier and/or the URL of the

    material would be generated and entered into the National

    Database.

2D. All entries within the National Hash & URL List Database shall be

    made through encrypted channels and strictly confined to the

    hash identifier and/or URL of the material confirmed to be

    CSEAM.

2E. Every entry within the National Hash & URL List Database shall

    be used by intermediaries to cross-check against and remove any

    content on their platform that matches the same. Law enforcement

    agencies shall further use the same process to identify, detect and

    remove any such material matched against an entry within the

    database across the internet.

2F. The process of detection and removal of CSEAM by cross-checking

    against an entry within the National Hash & URL List Database

    shall be done alongside and in addition to the ordinary existing

    process of detection and removal of CSEAM.

2G. Where an intermediary finds a match against an entry within the

    Hash & URL List Database i.e., CSEAM of “Known Origin”, the

    intermediary shall immediately disable and remove the same,

    without awaiting any further verification at its end.

2H. Where, an intermediary detects and removes any CSEAM of

    “Unknown Origin”, the same must be preceded by proper

    verification and due diligence on its part in accordance with the

    IT Rules. The intermediary in such a case shall also be obligated

    to promptly report the same to the proper authorities under the

    relevant law, and also to the designated body for the Hash & URL

    List Database, if not the same.

2I. Upon receipt of such report, the designated body for the Hash &

    URL List Database shall assess the flagged material in question in

    the manner indicated above. Where the same is confirmed to be

    CSEAM, the hash and/or URL identifier of the same would be

    entered into the database.
